t: Vietnam’s last imperial dynasty, founded by Gia Long in 1802 after he defeated the Tay Son and united the country.
Minh Mang built a centralised Confucian state on the Qing model, renamed the country Dai Nam and occupied Cambodia.
French conquest from 1858 reduced the emperors to figureheads, and Bao Dai abdicated to the Viet Minh in 1945.
dyk: The name Viet Nam was granted by the Qing emperor Jiaqing in 1804, after Gia Long asked for Nam Viet, which recalled the ancient kingdom of Nanyue in southern China.
ev: Nguyen Anh proclaims himself Gia Long and unites Vietnam
The Gia Long Code, modelled on Qing law, is issued
Minh Mang renames the country Dai Nam
A Franco-Spanish expedition attacks Da Nang
The Treaty of Saigon cedes three provinces of Cochinchina to France
Treaties make Annam and Tonkin French protectorates
Emperor Ham Nghi flees Hue and the Can Vuong resistance begins
Bao Dai abdicates to the Viet Minh on 30 August

f.successor: Empire of Vietnam (1945); Democratic Republic of Vietnam
